title: Run BFS
description: Perform Breadth-First Search from the source node to find shortest paths to all other nodes.

title: Record Distances
description: Store the distance to each reachable node discovered during BFS.

title: Sum Distances
description: Calculate the total sum of distances to all reachable nodes.

title: Compute Centrality
description: Divide the number of reachable nodes (excluding self) by the total distance to get the closeness centrality between 0 and 1.
